question: Who was selected to write the International Dance Day message in 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Mikhail Baryshnikov**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• International Dance Day: 29 April.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Event:** International Dance Day

 
 
• 
 
**Date:** Celebrated every year on **29 April**

 
 
• 
 
**Created by:** Dance Committee of the **International Theatre Institute (ITI)**

 
 
• 
 
**Main Partner:** ITI is the **main partner of UNESCO** for performing arts

 
 
• 
 
**Inception Year:** **1982**

 
 
• 
 
**Tradition:** Each year, an **outstanding dance personality** is selected to write a message

 
 
• 
 
**2025 Message Author:** **Mikhail Baryshnikov**
